steps.label: Immunity
steps.why: Immunity is a capacity, not a structure, which is why it is defined as an ability.
common_mistakes: Defining immunity as a set of organs. That is the immune system.
steps.memory_tip: Immunity is what the body CAN do; the immune system is what DOES it.

steps.label: Immune system
steps.why: It is called a system because organs, cells and proteins all take part, not one organ alone.
common_mistakes: Naming only white blood cells. Organs and proteins are part of it too.
steps.memory_tip: Organs, cells and proteins working as one network.
steps.margin_note: Name all three kinds of parts.

insider_note: Two definitions, one mark each. Immunity is an ability; the immune system is the machinery. Keep them clearly apart.
